$comment: Overlay — the full-viewport dim that modal surfaces sit on. This is the primitive Modal is built from, and the one every other above-the-page surface (image viewer, mobile sheet, menu) should be built from too: it owns the scrim, the escape routes and the scroll lock so nothing else has to hand-roll them. It carries no fill, border or radius of its own — those belong to whatever is placed on it.

scrim-bg.comment: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

fg.comment: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

viewport-padding.comment: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens
